subject.title: [Bug]: publishable plugin runtime builds cannot emit native CJS entrypoints

question: Should maintainers accept `openclaw.build.runtimeFormat` as the package-build knob for publishing msteams with native `.cjs` runtime sidecars?
rationale: The source bug is clear, but the fix changes official plugin package metadata and installed-package startup artifacts, which repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Review and land the linked PR
options.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 is repaired/reviewed, then close it after the CJS package contract is accepted and merged.

options.title: Reject the CJS build surface
options.body: Close or revise the linked PR if maintainers decide publishable plugin runtime packages should stay ESM-only for now.

options.title: Choose another packaging design
options.body: Keep the issue open but replace `runtimeFormat` with the preferred internal package-build mechanism before publishing msteams artifacts.

recommendation.title: Review and land the linked PR
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open while https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/102366 is repaired/reviewed, then close it after the CJS package contract is accepted and merged.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest recent history on the package-local npm runtime builder that would own the build contract decision.
